summary.text: Paul Skudlarek is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing records that Paul Skudlarek lost general-election races for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 5 in 2018 and 2020 and Rockingham 16 in 2024.
